_comment: The data pack regions. Bounds are minlon,minlat,maxlon,maxlat (WGS84). Basemaps are cut per region so a phone installs only what it needs; routing and search are built once for the whole state (nys) so cross-region trips work. core/packs Regions.kt mirrors this file and a unit test keeps the two in step.
